disposition.rationale: 'Why five axes' is unargued and the neighbours (8values, Lewis, Caplan) go unnamed; state the selection principle and situate the alternatives.
disposition.adaptedText: Five axes, not eight, because each earns its place by predicting a coalition the others cannot.

disposition.rationale: The CHES-derived composites are unfalsifiable and irreproducible as presented; caption the method and mark the caveat.
The Trump and Orbán profiles violate the essay's own rules and read as Misleading; correct them against C23a/d.
Attribution debts to Müller, Akkerman, welfare chauvinism, and Collier & Mahon; add the citations.
Whether to retitle the piece is an identity-level call for the author; escalated and resolved by guidance in favour of the working title.
The second read's 'graveyard of compasses' framing misreads the piece's purpose; the typology is a predictive instrument, not another compass. Clarify the framing paragraph but hold the design.
A full worked Green-party example is worth doing but belongs to the next round's agenda.
